svg.title: Neck, skin ramp 3, three-quarter view facing right. A CYLINDER, not a rectangle: the leading edge carries the ramp's shade and the trailing edge its light. Its own part, drawn below the torso, so the collar closes over its base and the head over its top. 26 px of skin inside a 38 px ink outer: 0.37 of the head's width, where the old 22 px column under a larger head read as a stalk. Length is measured, not chosen: art-bible.md 7.3.
